Soon after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]]''' [[Felucian warrior|warrior]] from the [[Felucian Sanctuary]] served as a guide for a group of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] agents in their quest to raid the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] prison facility called the [[Vanishing Place]] and liberate [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilder Varth]]. The guide led them to an unguarded entrance to the facility, but was soon killed by Imperial forces.
